description: Decides whether two songs will mix well, from their keys and BPMs, using the Camelot wheel and DJ tempo limits (about 3% sounds natural, up to about 16% is usable, half and double time count). Returns a verdict, the tempo change in percent and the target BPM for track B, the smallest key shift in semitones if the keys clash, and a link to make the matched audio.

key_a.description: Track A key. Musical key: a name like "A minor", "Am", "F#m", "Bb major", "C", or a Camelot code like "8A".

key_b.description: Track B key (the one that would be changed). Musical key: a name like "A minor", "Am", "F#m", "Bb major", "C", or a Camelot code like "8A".

name: check_mix
title: Check if two songs mix
